mechanic.fanatical-hatred.effect: Hates every member of the eleven warband categories printed in the source — Orcs and Goblins, Black Orcs, Forest Goblins, Horned Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar, Middenheimers, Skaven, Undead, Beastmen, Possessed and Carnival of Chaos — regardless of that member’s own species.

effect_i18n.es: Odia a todo miembro de las once categorías de banda impresas en la fuente — Orcos y Goblins, Orcos Negros, Goblins del Bosque, Cazadores Cornudos, Hermanas de Sigmar, Middenheim, Skaven, No Muertos, Hombres Bestia, Posesos y Carnaval del Caos — independientemente de la especie de ese miembro.

mechanic.giggle-juice-spray.effect: Once per battle may replace one normal close-combat attack with an automatic Strength2 Giggle Juice hit that adds +1 Injury. The additional Nervous Condition after battle is excluded.

effect_i18n.es: Once per battle may replace one normal close-combat attack with an automatic Strength2 Giggle Juice hit that adds +1 Injury. The additional Nervous Condition after battle is excluded.

mechanic.centaur-trample.effect: One additional natural attack at own Strength; it receives no weapon bonuses or penalties.

effect_i18n.es: One additional natural attack at own Strength; it receives no weapon bonuses or penalties.

mechanic.djinn-ethereal.effect: Unmodifiable5+ save ineffective against magical weapons.

effect_i18n.es: Unmodifiable5+ save ineffective against magical weapons.

mechanic.daemonic-flesh.effect: The daemon has a 5+ unmodified armour save, negated by magical or blessed weapons and spells. Its own attacks count as magical.

effect_i18n.es: The daemon has a 5+ unmodified armour save, negated by magical or blessed weapons and spells. Its own attacks count as magical.

mechanic.excellent-reflexes.effect: The Tomb Robber has a 5+ special save against any attack. If he knows Dodge, this improves to 4+.

effect_i18n.es: The Tomb Robber has a 5+ special save against any attack. If he knows Dodge, this improves to 4+.

condition.tomb-robber-dodge-known.effect: This Tomb Robber has learned Dodge; Excellent Reflexes improves to 4+ against attacks. The shooting action of Dodge is excluded.

effect_i18n.es: This Tomb Robber has learned Dodge; Excellent Reflexes improves to 4+ against attacks. The shooting action of Dodge is excluded.

mechanic.solkan-inquisitor.effect: At the beginning of each new round of combat roll a D6 for an opponent who is neither Undead nor a follower of Chaos. On a 6 apply a D66 Random Mutation as a brand. The Inquisitor is immune to Psychology.

effect_i18n.es: Al comienzo de cada nueva ronda de combate tira un D6 por un oponente que no sea No Muerto ni seguidor del Caos. Con un 6 aplica una Mutación Aleatoria D66 como marca. El Inquisidor es inmune a la psicología.

mechanic.solkan-witch-finder.effect: The chosen War-Priest must charge an eligible follower of Chaos, warlock, necromancer, sorcerer or warp-tainted character; only the supplied actual charge is resolved, without movement or visibility production.

effect_i18n.es: El Sacerdote de Guerra elegido debe cargar contra un seguidor elegible del Caos, brujo, nigromante, hechicero o personaje contaminado por la disformidad; solo se resuelve la carga real suministrada, sin producir movimiento ni visibilidad.

condition.witch-finder-charge.effect: The selected Solkan Witch-finder is making the actual compulsory charge against the supplied eligible reachable opponent.

mechanic.emissary-nurgle.effect: All attacks are poisoned as Black Lotus and the Emissary causes Fear.

mechanic.emissary-slaanesh.effect: All enemies must pass Leadership to charge the Emissary. An enemy engaging him in close combat suffers -1 to hit.

mechanic.bear-handler.effect: A Kislevite Warband that includes a Bear Tamer is allowed to purchase a Bear as a henchman. This bear has been trained to follow the Tamer's commands, and so will automatically pass its stupidity tests when within 6" of the Bear Tamer (even if the Tamer has been Knocked Down or Stunned).

effect_i18n.es: Una Banda Kislevita que incluya un Domador de osos puede comprar un Oso como secuaz. Este oso ha sido adiestrado para seguir las órdenes del Domador, por lo que supera automáticamente sus chequeos de Estupidez cuando está a 6" del Domador de osos (incluso si el Domador ha sido Derribado o Aturdido).

mechanic.bear-handler-recipient.effect: This trained bear follows its actual friendly Bear Tamer within 6 inches; the Tamer may be Knocked Down or Stunned, but cannot be Out of Action.

effect_i18n.es: This trained bear follows its actual friendly Bear Tamer within 6 inches; the Tamer may be Knocked Down or Stunned, but cannot be Out of Action.

condition.bear-handler-nearby.effect: The Trained Bear has its actual friendly Bear Tamer within 6 inches. This exempts Stupidity; an Out of Action Tamer does not qualify.

effect_i18n.es: The Trained Bear has its actual friendly Bear Tamer within 6 inches. This exempts Stupidity; an Out of Action Tamer does not qualify.

condition.stupidity-exempt.effect: The Rat Ogre has its actual qualifying Skaven Hero within 6 inches, so the printed Stupidity exemption applies and no Stupidity test is taken. The caller supplies the exemption; the duel neither simulates the surrounding warband nor measures table positions.

mechanic.dim-witted-leader.effect: If the Barbarian is the warband's leader then he has an effective Leadership of 7 for warband members within 6\" and Rout tests.

effect_i18n.es: Si el Bárbaro es el líder de la banda, tiene un Liderazgo efectivo de 7 para los miembros de la banda a 6" y para las tiradas de Huida.

condition.adventurer-barbarian-leader.effect: This native Adventurer Barbarian is the actual chosen warband Leader. Dim-witted changes only his Leadership lent to friends within 6 inches, not his own Leadership.

effect_i18n.es: This native Adventurer Barbarian is the actual chosen warband Leader. Dim-witted changes only his Leadership lent to friends within 6 inches, not his own Leadership.

condition.current-warband-leader.effect: This warrior is the actual current leader of its warband, a state the caller supplies. The position carries the printed Leader rule, so any warband warrior within 6 inches may use this warrior's Leadership; a band skill may widen that radius and both rules stay the position's own.

effect_i18n.es: Este guerrero es el líder actual de su banda, un estado que aporta el llamador. La posición lleva la regla impresa de Líder, de modo que cualquier guerrero de la banda a 6" puede usar el Liderazgo de este guerrero; una habilidad de banda puede ampliar ese radio y ambas reglas siguen siendo de la posición.

condition.poetry-victorious-leader.effect: The actual Leader of this Ghutani, Muzil or Turjuk band won its previous battle and receives +1 Leadership for its first actual Leadership test this scenario. Rerolls use that same threshold; this is not a bonus to Leadership lent to friends.

effect_i18n.es: The actual Leader of this Ghutani, Muzil or Turjuk band won its previous battle and receives +1 Leadership for its first actual Leadership test this scenario. Rerolls use that same threshold; this is not a bonus to Leadership lent to friends.

condition.poetry-inspired.effect: The supplied friendly recipient within 6 inches of its Poet receives +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Attack for this initial player turn only. Prior victory is not required for this separate inspiration.

effect_i18n.es: The supplied friendly recipient within 6 inches of its Poet receives +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Attack for this initial player turn only. Prior victory is not required for this separate inspiration.

condition.command.raise-our-insignia.effect: The supplied eligible friendly recipient may reroll Leadership during the current Recovery/Movement period. This command expires at the beginning of the next Shooting phase, before the ensuing close combat. The command/casting and other models are not produced.

effect_i18n.es: The supplied eligible friendly recipient may reroll Leadership during the current Recovery/Movement period. This command expires at the beginning of the next Shooting phase, before the ensuing close combat. The command/casting and other models are not produced.

condition.netted.effect: The supplied victim caught in a net counts as Knocked Down and is hit automatically in combat; the attacker must still wound. In its next own Recovery, unless Stunned or Out of Action, it cuts free, performs no other action and strikes last as if it stood up. No shooting or charge producer is simulated.

condition.nuttaz-charge.effect: This native Orc Nuttaz is making its actual compulsory charge against the supplied nearest visible reachable enemy. The caller supplies target qualification; no movement, visibility search or run is produced.

effect_i18n.es: This native Orc Nuttaz is making its actual compulsory charge against the supplied nearest visible reachable enemy. The caller supplies target qualification; no movement, visibility search or run is produced.

condition.goading-charge.effect: This supplied Moulder beast is actually charging as the result of successful Goading. Such a charge bypasses Hypnotic Musk. Goading rolls, movement and other results are not produced.

effect_i18n.es: This supplied Moulder beast is actually charging as the result of successful Goading. Such a charge bypasses Hypnotic Musk. Goading rolls, movement and other results are not produced.

mechanic.herb-lore-outside-combat.effect: In its own Recovery a Ranger outside close combat may heal itself one Wound on 4+, up to its normal Wounds. Healing a friendly separate model and movement are not produced.

effect_i18n.es: In its own Recovery a Ranger outside close combat may heal itself one Wound on 4+, up to its normal Wounds. Healing a friendly separate model and movement are not produced.

mechanic.veskit-no-pain.effect: Veskit loses Wounds normally but ignores Knocked Down and Stunned Injury results. Only an actual Out of Action Injury result removes him; losing the last Wound is not itself automatic removal.

effect_i18n.es: Veskit loses Wounds normally but ignores Knocked Down and Stunned Injury results. Only an actual Out of Action Injury result removes him; losing the last Wound is not itself automatic removal.

mechanic.wall-of-steel.effect: Even the most lowly of Ashigaru is a veteran of hours of drill, and because of this if wielding a spear you may choose to wield it two-handed, in which case the spear gains the parry special rule.

effect_i18n.es: Incluso el más humilde de los Ashigaru es un veterano de horas de instrucción, y por esto, si empuña una lanza, puedes elegir empuñarla a dos manos, en cuyo caso la lanza gana la regla especial Parada.

mechanic.whip-master.effect: May reroll each own hit roll made with this whip once, accepting the second result even if worse; no battle resource.

effect_i18n.es: Puede repetir una vez cada tirada propia para impactar con el látigo; acepta el segundo resultado, sin recurso por batalla.

mechanic.fear-of-snakes.effect: The bearer fears snakes and serpents using ordinary Fear consequences; this grants no Fear to the bearer.

effect_i18n.es: El portador teme a serpientes; se aplican las consecuencias ordinarias de Miedo y no causa Miedo por ello.

mechanic.drenok-berserker.effect: When reduced to zero Wounds, a 4+ keeps Drenok standing and fighting for this turn. Roll every subsequent player turn while at zero; failure takes him Out of Action. No Wound is restored.

effect_i18n.es: Al llegar a cero Heridas, un 4+ permite seguir luchando durante el turno sin recuperar Heridas; repite cada turno posterior y un fallo lo deja Fuera de combate.

condition.ye-give-way-refused.effect: The Hero who refused a prior challenge has -1 to hit in melee until the end of the game, non-cumulative.

effect_i18n.es: Modificador individual persistente del resultado suministrado de Ye Give Way.

condition.ye-give-way-victorious.effect: A Fallen Noble who put the challenged opponent Out of Action has +1 to hit in melee and +1 Strength until the end of the game, non-cumulative.

effect_i18n.es: Un Noble Caído que dejó Fuera de Combate al oponente desafiado tiene +1 a impactar en cuerpo a cuerpo y +1 Fuerza hasta el final de la partida, sin acumularse.

condition.disability-1.effect: Lame and arthritic: minus one Movement and Initiative. Supplied permanent result.

effect_i18n.es: Cojo y artrítico: -1 Movimiento y -1 Iniciativa. Resultado permanente suministrado.

condition.disability-2.effect: Parkinson: minus one Weapon Skill; cannot use two weapons or a weapon and shield. Supplied permanent result.

effect_i18n.es: Parkinson: -1 Habilidad de Arma; no puede usar dos armas ni un arma y escudo. Resultado permanente suministrado.

condition.disability-3.effect: Poor eyesight: minus one Ballistic Skill; no shooting action is simulated. Supplied permanent result.

effect_i18n.es: Vista pobre: -1 Habilidad de Proyectiles; no se simula la acción de disparo. Resultado permanente suministrado.

condition.disability-4.effect: Sickly: minus one Toughness. Supplied permanent result.

effect_i18n.es: Resultado permanente suministrado de Discapacidad.

condition.disability-5.effect: Weakness: minus one Strength. Supplied permanent result.

effect_i18n.es: Resultado permanente suministrado de Discapacidad.

condition.disability-6.effect: Head injury: Stupidity unless within six inches of a Hero. Supplied permanent result.

effect_i18n.es: Lesión craneal: Estupidez salvo que esté a seis pulgadas o menos de un Héroe. Resultado permanente suministrado.

condition.disability-hero-nearby.effect: Current supplied Hero proximity for Head Injury only.

effect_i18n.es: Proximidad actual de un Heroe para Lesion craneal.

mechanic.man-hater.effect: Hatred of human males, using the individual opponent species and sex rather than warband affiliation.

effect_i18n.es: Odio contra varones humanos segun la especie y sexo del oponente individual.

mechanic.despise-despoilers.effect: The Dark Mage hates Necromancers and adversaries using Necromancy or Dreaded Scrolls of Nagash spells in the first round of close combat.

effect_i18n.es: El Mago Oscuro odia a los Nigromantes y a los adversarios que usan Nigromancia o los Pergaminos Temidos de Nagash durante la primera ronda de combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

mechanic.ashamed-and-afraid.effect: The Fallen Sister must pass a Leadership test before charging a Sisters of Sigmar warband or a Warrior-Priest of a Witch Hunters warband; failure prevents the declared charge.

effect_i18n.es: La Hermana Caída debe superar una prueba de Liderazgo antes de cargar contra una banda de Hermanas de Sigmar o un Sacerdote Guerrero de una banda de Cazadores de Brujas; si falla, la carga declarada no se realiza.
